title: Replace Airtable With a Custom Tool Built in an Afternoon (Save $240-$2,400/Year)
summary: Airtable costs $20-$45/user/month for features most teams use 30% of. Build a custom database app with AI that does exactly what you need — database and auth included, no Supabase needed.
body_markdown: Go to[blink.new](https://blink.new/) . Describe your tool: "Build a project tracking database with tasks, owners, due dates, and status (To Do, In Progress, Done). Add table view and kanban view. Include user authentication with admin and editor roles." Blink builds the full-stack app — database, auth, and hosting included automatically. No Supabase account needed, no Firebase project, no deployment config.
